prompts.name: actions-08.prompt.txt
prompts.text:
Use case: precise-object-edit, identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent 4-by-4 animation sprite atlas for the same chibi blue-haired Dafeiyu priest character.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: priest/actions-08.png, sixteen existing poses in fixed 4x4 row-major cells.
Image 2 is the EQUIPMENT REFERENCE ONLY: priest base frame-00.png. It is not a new pose or layout to copy.

Repair the target atlas carefully. Its persistent golden staff has been omitted. Restore that exact gold leaf/spear-shaped staff head with its short shaft behind the character's screen-left shoulder in every pose. Use the reference's size, gold shape, mounting/position relationship, and proportions. In each near-front pose the gold staff head remains on screen LEFT; do not swap it to screen right. It follows the torso tilt, never becomes a handheld action prop, and remains legible except where an existing hand, card fan, or hair legitimately occludes it. Preserve the reference's exact floating gold crown/halo, cream shoulder trim, cream-and-burgundy gold-edged robe, vertical central gold motif, pale blue waist jewel, and dark gold-trim shoes. Keep these persistent outfit details as close as possible in all 16 cells. Do not change the character's equipment into a new outfit.

Keep every original pose, face/expression, hand position, prop, thought bubble, ground effect, body orientation, grid placement and cell size from IMAGE 1. This is a localized persistent-equipment restoration, not a redesigned atlas. Do not copy the neutral reference pose into the action cells. All 16 actions/stages remain distinct:
Row 1: thinking with hand at chin and thought dots; idea with pointing finger and lightbulb; archive reading a page over ledger/papers; archive writing with feather.
Row 2: two alternating forward jogging poses; two humming poses with musical notes and open arms.
Row 3: two card-magic poses (small held deck then fan of cards); sleepy drooping pose with Z marks; startled awake pose with raised hands.
Row 4: two spinning-top/whip action stages (raised whip then low sweep toward spinning top); opening gift box; excited glowing open gift.
Keep cards, books, keyboard-free papers, whip/top, and gift box exactly recognizable, separate from the restored staff. Keep existing visual ordering and no extra sprites. No labels, no watermarks, no borders, no background scene.
Preserve a true transparent RGBA background including between cells. Do not paint black or white background. Output one square 4x4 atlas, full-resolution crisp clean linework, same composition and margins as target, no cropped appendages.
